articles.title: Bitcoin Miners Are Selling Their Stacks to Fund the AI Boom
articles.description: MARA sold 13,597 BTC after September and Riot sold 20,264 BTC through September to fund debt repayment and AI data center buildouts, as Glassnode flagged the pair as the main sellers among Bitcoin treasury firms.

articles.title: Fed's Waller Calls for 50-Basis-Point Rate Hike, Says Tokenized Finance Still Needs Traditional Banks
articles.description: Christopher Waller says stubborn inflation may warrant a bigger December rate hike, while a separate speech outlined why blockchain-based payments still need traditional settlement systems and stronger safeguards to scale.

articles.title: Lucky Trader Banks 66,000% Profit on GTA 6 Meme Coin Ticker Confusion
articles.description: The trader turned $300 into over $200,000 as early footage of GTA 6 sent degens flocking between different token tickers.

articles.title: 'It Speaks in Tongues That Only 6.2 Astra Understands': Why Early Testers Hate OpenAI’s New Model
articles.description: OpenAI's flagship AI model is dazzling developers with 3D creations, but early testers say it stalls during long projects, gives baffling explanations, and hides failures.

articles.title: Movie2K Defendant Could Hand Over 40,000 Bitcoin to End Trial—and Stay a Billionaire
articles.description: A German judge has offered to drop the charges if the alleged operator of the piracy site gives up most of his remaining Bitcoin.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Nvidia Beats, Board Says ‘No’ on Jensen
articles.description: Nvidia delivered its best earnings ever and raised forward guidance. And yet, the market mostly shrugged. What does it mean?

articles.title: 'Doomed From the Start': President Trump's Meme Coin Hits New Lows After Midterms
articles.description: The TRUMP token has fallen almost 40% since election day, with analysts pointing to the Democrats’ subpoena plans, fading interest, and a heavy unlock schedule.

articles.title: AI Will Make the Next 12 Months 'a Slaughterhouse' for Crypto Security: Anchorage Exec
articles.description: Security chiefs at Solana's Breakpoint said AI is lowering the bar for hackers, as North Korea steps up its attacks on crypto firms.

articles.title: Scattered Spider Hacker Sentenced to 6 Years Over $11.6M in Stolen Crypto
articles.description: Scotland's Tyler Buchanan is the last of five defendants sentenced in a phishing and SIM-swapping scheme that targeted crypto holders.

articles.title: Why Microsoft Thinks Smaller, Cheaper AI Can Beat Claude and GPT
articles.description: Microsoft's new coding, cybersecurity and image models challenge bigger rivals on performance and price. The company's bet is that doing one job exceptionally well matters more than doing absolutely everything.

articles.title: Nvidia Board Shuts Down Jensen Huang Comeback, Launches Search for New CEO
articles.description: Nvidia's board rejected a comeback for its ousted co-founder as it hired a search firm, backed interim CEO Colette Kress, and tightened oversight of chip exports to China.

articles.title: Nvidia Shares Rise After Earnings Beat in First Report Since Jensen Huang's Exit
articles.description: The chipmaker doubled quarterly revenue, forecast another record and rallied after hours, but its first report without Jensen Huang leaves leadership questions and a deeply bruised stock chart unresolved.

articles.title: OpenAI's GPT 6.2 Astra Challenges Anthropic on Price, But Not Every Benchmark
articles.description: OpenAI's latest models promise better professional work for less money, as the company battles Anthropic and Google for AI supremacy and faces tougher questions about increasingly capable systems and safety.

articles.title: World Bank Taps Circle and Citi to Test Stablecoins for Development Payments
articles.description: The institution will test whether Circle’s USDC and blockchain rails can speed up and cut the cost of disbursing development funds.

articles.title: Bitcoin Investors Are Capitulating—That’s Historically Been a Bottom Signal
articles.description: Glassnode says Bitcoin’s realized losses have reached levels seen only near the 2018, 2020, 2022 and early 2023 lows, as buyers defend the $62,000 to $66,000 range.

articles.title: Cathie Wood's ARK Sells $85 Million in Nvidia, Buys $40 Million in Crypto Stocks
articles.description: Cathie Wood's funds trimmed Nvidia ahead of earnings while buying Block, Circle and Coinbase during Monday's selloff.

articles.title: Ethereum Devs Weigh a Scaling Upgrade That Could Break 15,000 Apps
articles.description: Developers warned on a core dev call that two scaling changes in the Glamsterdam upgrade break assumptions some contracts rely on—pitting a 3.3x capacity boost against the risk of disrupting thousands of apps.

articles.title: Jensen Huang Says He'd Be 'Honored' to Return as Nvidia CEO, Despite Board's Resistance
articles.description: The ousted Nvidia founder apologized for his conduct, offered to return if directors ask, and addressed supporters as the chipmaker presses ahead with its search for new leadership this week.

articles.title: Binance Hack Wallets Move $137 Million in Ethereum After Two Weeks of Silence
articles.description: A wallet linked to October’s record Binance theft moved $63 million in ether, before analysts flagged a larger wave of transfers and reported Bitcoin swaps amid ongoing U.S. recovery efforts.

articles.title: Former Robinhood Engineer Pleads Guilty to Crypto Insider Trading Scheme
articles.description: Huaisong Xiang admitted repeatedly trading perpetual futures on Hyperliquid using confidential Robinhood listing plans, pocketing $125,523.

articles.title: Standard Life Chair Wants Tokenized Gilts to Open UK Government Bonds to Retail Savers
articles.description: Sir Nicholas Lyons told Solana's Breakpoint that tokenization should benefit ordinary investors, not just wholesale institutions.

articles.title: Morning Minute: The CFTC Officially Greenlights Perps in the US, Starting with Backpack
articles.description: CFTC chairman Mike Selig said he looks forward to building on this milestone, which begs the question—who’s next?

articles.title: 'The Biggest Opportunity in Crypto Is Already Underway': Solana Bets Big on AI Agents
articles.description: The Solana Foundation's head of AI said agents now account for three-quarters of AI token use, and need blockchains to pay for things.

articles.title: Optimizely Hack Hijacked Ledger, BBC and 176 Other Sites to Swap Crypto Wallet Addresses
articles.description: Malicious code served through the website testing platform replaced visitors' wallet addresses with the attacker's and skimmed cards.

articles.title: Nvidia Board Not Considering Jensen Huang's Return: Report
articles.description: The board is focused on its probe into the ousted co-founder, a source told CNBC, despite Donald Trump and Elon Musk backing his return.

articles.title: Judge Acquits MIT Brothers in $25M Ethereum MEV Case, Ending Prosecution
articles.description: A federal judge ruled prosecutors failed to prove the material misrepresentation needed for wire fraud, a year after a jury deadlocked.

articles.title: Solana Foundation Backs CoinGecko as Crypto Data Giant Eyes Trading
articles.description: CoinGecko has received backing from the Solana Foundation to expand into market intelligence and explore trading.

articles.title: Alibaba's Qwen 4 Max Leads China's AI Agent Race—But You Can't Download It
articles.description: Alibaba's new flagship jumps ahead of Chinese rivals on agent and web design leaderboards, with cheaper API access. The closed model also previews the next generation of open Qwen releases.

articles.title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Trezor Says Customer Data Was Exposed Again
articles.description: A second Trezor shipping partner was breached in three months, exposing buyers' addresses and order details.

articles.title: Bitcoin's $2 Billion Liquidation Weekend Leaves Traders Watching $60,000
articles.description: Bitcoin fell near $62,100 as forced liquidations swept crypto markets. ETF withdrawals and a crowded options trade offer a closer look at the damage left behind.

articles.title: Hackers Redirected Bitcoin Miner Rewards via AI Attack, Luxor CEO Says
articles.description: Luxor said hackers redirected hashrate from just over a dozen client accounts through its Commander tool, and its CEO blamed a “sophisticated AI-enabled vector.”

articles.title: Tom Lee Blames Nvidia and Anthropic IPO for Ethereum Plunge as Bitmine Buys the Dip
articles.description: The firm’s stash fell to $11.8 billion from $14.3 billion a week earlier as ETH slid 28% in two weeks, a “waterfall” drop chairman Tom Lee blames on Nvidia fallout and cash-raising ahead of Anthropic’s IPO.

articles.title: Clarity Act Defeat ‘Failure of American Leadership’: Trump’s Former Crypto Chief
articles.description: Former White House crypto chief Patrick Witt said the Clarity Act "lost against the clock," and regulators will now set the rules.

articles.title: Trump Backs Jensen Huang’s Return to Nvidia as Sam Altman Says 'Heroes Have Flaws'
articles.description: Trump would welcome Nvidia’s co-founder back. Altman, who survived his own CEO ouster, sympathizes but stops short of endorsing Huang’s comeback.

articles.title: Fed Is Modeling AI 'Super Intelligence' Scenarios, Including Job Losses and a Stock Market Slump
articles.description: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh says staff are studying three possible economic futures for AI, ranging from widespread productivity gains to higher unemployment and a painful correction in technology stocks.

articles.title: Nvidia Stock Has a 20% Rebound in Sight—If Bulls Can Clear a Hurdle
articles.description: Nvidia shares tanked specularly last week amid the Jensen Huang scandal. Is it in for a major rebound? Here’s what the charts suggest.

articles.title: Saylor’s Strategy Keeps Buying Bitcoin, Adding 'A Little Orange' Through the Dip
articles.description: The modest purchase lifted Strategy’s stash to 850,849 BTC as chairman Michael Saylor shrugged off a sharp downturn, posting that “this dip could use a little orange.”
